claim_boundary.scope: Independent CoefDtMin numerical root-cause repair to achieve true adaptive floor-safe timestep integration for CELL3 single-axis sloshing

root_cause_analysis.problem_statement: In NOMINAL, TIME (half-CFL), and QUARTER (quarter-CFL) historical and prospective runs, exactly 99.9999% of all simulation substeps were artificially clamped to DtMin (DTs adjusted to DtMin: 754,844 / 1,509,684 / 3,019,366). The solver never executed in an adaptive timestep regime, but ran as fixed-step Symplectic integration clamped at an artificial floor.

source_code_lineage.adaptive_step_formula: src/source/JSphGpu.cpp:1104-1137: dt2 = KernelH / (max(Cs0, VelMax * 10.) + KernelH * ViscDtMax); dt = CFLnumber * min(dt1, min(dt2, dt3))
source_code_lineage.floor_clamp_logic: src/source/JSphGpu.cpp:1131: if (dt < DtMin) { dt = DtMin; DtModif++; }

mathematical_mechanism.derivation: Because fluid velocity and viscous dissipation terms are non-negative, the Courant denominator (max(Cs0, VelMax*10.) + KernelH*ViscDtMax) is strictly greater than Cs0 whenever viscous dissipation or fluid motion is present. Therefore, dt2 < KernelH / Cs0 = tau_sound. Consequently, dt_adaptive <= CFLnumber * dt2 < CFLnumber * (KernelH / Cs0). In the previous case configurations, CoefDtMin was set exactly equal to CFLnumber (0.05, 0.025, 0.0125). Thus, DtMin = CoefDtMin * (KernelH / Cs0) = CFLnumber * (KernelH / Cs0) > dt_adaptive. This guaranteed dt_adaptive < DtMin at every single step, permanently triggering the clamp.

root_cause_analysis.repair_strategy: Decouple CoefDtMin from CFLnumber by placing the minimum timestep floor 10x below the nominal Courant timestep. The floor then acts as a numerical safety net against unphysical singularities (particle overlap) while permitting natural SPH adaptive timestep dynamics across the physical flow.

repair_attempts.role: Baseline CFL with decoupled adaptive floor
repair_attempts.hypothesis: Restores genuine adaptive SPH timestepping at nominal CFL=0.05. Floor incidence will collapse from 99.9997% to < 1%, allowing fluid particles to respond to dynamic local accelerations and shear without artificial numerical clamping.

repair_attempts.role: Half-CFL refinement with decoupled adaptive floor
repair_attempts.hypothesis: Evaluates genuine adaptive CFL-halving convergence by comparing Case 1 (CFL 0.05, adaptive) and Case 2 (CFL 0.025, adaptive) in a regime where neither simulation is distorted by constant-step floor clamping.
